help.analyze.txt:
Description:
  Analyze AL source without compiling it: affected apps, dependency graph, object graph, changed objects, public API, referenced objects, and impacted tests.

Usage:
  AlWasp analyze [<targetOrProfile>] [options]

Arguments:
  <targetOrProfile>  Configured target or profile whose projects are analyzed

Options:
  --project <project>              Single AL project directory (default: current directory when there is no alwasp.json)
  --project-root <project-root>    Root directory in which AL projects are discovered recursively
  --workspace <workspace>          VS Code workspace file; selects only folders directly containing app.json
  --include <include>              Sections to produce (default: all): affected-apps, dependency-graph, object-graph, changed-objects, public-api, references, impacted-tests. Repeatable, or comma-separated.
  --changed-since <changed-since>  Base git reference the source is compared against: 'latest' (newest local tag), 'latest:<pattern>' (newest local tag matching a glob), 'latest-merge:<text>' (nearest first-parent merge whose message contains the text), or an explicit tag/branch/commit. Overrides 'changeDetection.base' in alwasp.json. Without it, changed objects, affected apps, and impacted tests are not evaluated.
  --max-depth <max-depth>          Stop propagating impact after this many reference hops (default: unbounded)
  --json <json>                    Write the full analysis report as JSON to this path
  --max-items <max-items>          Maximum entries listed per console section (0 lists all; --verbose implies 0) [default: 20]
  --config <config>                Path to alwasp.json project configuration file (auto-detected if omitted)
  --profile <profile>              Profile name in alwasp.json to build (config-driven mode)
  -v, --verbose                    Enable verbose logging
  -q, --quiet                      Minimal output
  --format <format>                Output format: text (default), json (a single result document on stdout, human output moved to stderr), or ndjson (one JSON record per line, written as the command runs). 'jsonl' is accepted for ndjson.
  --result-file <result-file>      Write the --format json/ndjson output to this file instead of stdout, leaving the console output unchanged. Use this for 'build', 'check', and 'workspace build', whose altool output cannot be redirected.
  -?, -h, --help                   Show help and usage information

help.build.txt:
Description:
  Compile the AL project. With alwasp.json: config-driven multi-project build using targets and profiles. With --project or --project-root: direct build of discovered projects and their local dependencies, without alwasp.json. Otherwise: single-project build from app.json using alc.

Usage:
  AlWasp build [<targetOrPath>] [options]

Arguments:
  <targetOrPath>  With alwasp.json: a target or profile name to build (default: defaultTarget from alwasp.json). Without alwasp.json: path to app.json for single-project build (default: ./app.json).

Options:
  --packages <packages>                          Path to the .alpackages symbol folder (default: .alpackages)
  --restore                                      Run incremental symbol restore before build (default behavior)
  --clean                                        Remove ALWasp package-cache and output artifacts before building (also log and manifest artifacts for config-driven builds)
  --latest                                       Use latest dependency versions when restoring
  --out <out>                                    Output .app file path. Cannot be combined with --outfolder.
  --outfolder <outfolder>                        Folder for the output .app file. Cannot be combined with --out.
  --warnaserror                                  Treat all warnings as errors
  --nowarn <nowarn>                              Warning codes to suppress (e.g. AL0001). Repeat to suppress multiple.
  --errorlog <errorlog>                          Write all diagnostics to this file
  --ruleset <ruleset>                            Ruleset file that overrides diagnostic severities
  --target <target>                              Compilation target (e.g. Cloud, OnPrem)
  --parallel                                     Enable parallel compilation
  --max-parallelism <max-parallelism>            Maximum number of parallel compilation tasks (implies --parallel)
  --define <define>                              Preprocessor symbols to define. Repeat to define multiple.
  --features <features>                          Feature flags to enable. Repeat to enable multiple.
  --codecop                                      Enable the CodeCop analyzer
  --appsourcecop                                 Enable the AppSourceCop analyzer
  --ptecop                                       Enable the PerTenantExtensionCop analyzer
  --uicop                                        Enable the UICop analyzer
  --custom-analyzers <custom-analyzers>          Paths to custom analyzer assemblies. Repeat to add multiple.
  -v, --verbose                                  Enable verbose logging
  -q, --quiet                                    Minimal output
  --feed <feed>                                  Additional NuGet feed URL. Repeat to add multiple feeds.
  --nuget-config <nuget-config>                  Path to nuget.config used for sources and credentials
  --auth-mode <Auto|Interactive|NonInteractive>  Authentication mode for private feeds: Auto, Interactive, NonInteractive
  --feed-token-env <feed-token-env>              Feed token mapping in form 'feedUrl=ENV_VAR'. Repeat to map multiple feeds.
  --pat <pat>                                    Personal Access Token for authenticated NuGet feeds. Falls back to ALWASP_PAT environment variable.
  --config <config>                              Path to alwasp.json project configuration file (auto-detected if omitted)
  --profile <profile>                            Profile name in alwasp.json to build (config-driven mode)
  --manifest <manifest>                          Write a config-driven build manifest to this path after the build. Specify a path or omit to use the default: .alwasp/build-manifest.json. Also settable via manifest in alwasp.json workspace or profile section.
  --continue-on-error                            Continue building remaining groups/profiles after a failure (overrides workspace.continueOnError in alwasp.json)
  --diagnostic, --diagnostics                    List the individual compiler findings (errors and analyzer warnings such as CodeCop/AppSourceCop/UICop) after each compile; the summary always counts them per analyzer (also settable via workspace.diagnostics in alwasp.json)
  --changed-since <changed-since>                Git reference: 'latest' (newest local tag), 'latest:<pattern>' (newest local tag matching a glob, e.g. 'latest:v*'), 'latest-merge:<text>' (nearest first-parent merge whose message contains the text), or an explicit tag/branch/commit. Config-driven mode: restricts 'versioning.applyTo: changedOnly' to projects changed since it and overrides 'changeDetection.base' in alwasp.json. With --project-root: builds only apps changed since it plus the apps that depend on them, and compiles their local dependencies.
  --plan <plan>                                  Build exactly the projects selected by a previously generated plan file. Cannot be combined with targetOrPath or --profile. Can be combined with --changed-since, which still only affects 'versioning.applyTo: changedOnly' resolution - it does not alter which projects the plan selects.
  --include-dependents                           With --project-root and --changed-since, also build the apps that (transitively) depend on a changed app (default: only changed apps and the local dependencies they need to compile).
  --project <project>                            Single AL project directory (direct mode; needs no alwasp.json). Cannot be combined with a positional target/path, --profile, --plan, --config, or --project-root.
  --project-root <project-root>                  Root directory in which AL projects are discovered recursively and built in dependency order (direct mode; needs no alwasp.json). Cannot be combined with a positional target/path, --profile, --plan, --config, or --project.
  --app <app>                                    With --project-root: build only this app, given by name, app ID, or project path relative to --project-root. Repeat for multiple apps. Required local dependencies are still compiled, as dependency-only apps.
  --bc-target <bc-target>                        Business Central target: current (default; Microsoft symbols from NuGet), next-minor, or next-major (Insider artifact for symbols, compiler and analyzers). Not available with a positional app.json build.
  --bc-version <bc-version>                      Pinned Business Central version, for example 27.5; mutually exclusive with --bc-target next-minor/next-major.
  --bc-country <bc-country>                      Exactly one Business Central country code (default: restore.country from alwasp.json, else W1), for example DE. A comma-separated list is not supported by build.
  --format <format>                              Output format: text (default), json (a single result document on stdout, human output moved to stderr), or ndjson (one JSON record per line, written as the command runs). 'jsonl' is accepted for ndjson.
  --result-file <result-file>                    Write the --format json/ndjson output to this file instead of stdout, leaving the console output unchanged. Use this for 'build', 'check', and 'workspace build', whose altool output cannot be redirected.
  -?, -h, --help                                 Show help and usage information
help.check.txt:
Description:
  Verify the selected AL projects against every configured ALWasp gate: configuration, restore, build, compiler diagnostics, compatibility, and translations. Test apps are compiled, not run.

Usage:
  AlWasp check [<targetOrProfile>] [options]

Arguments:
  <targetOrProfile>  Target or profile to check (default: defaultTarget from alwasp.json).

Options:
  --profile <profile>                            Profile name in alwasp.json to check. Cannot be combined with targetOrProfile.
  --changed-since <changed-since>                Check only the projects 'alwasp plan' would select for changes since this git reference (changed projects, dependents, affected test apps, and compile prerequisites). Supports explicit refs, 'latest:<pattern>', and 'latest-merge:<text>'. With --plan, it must resolve to the plan's own base.
  --plan <plan>                                  Check exactly the projects selected by a previously generated plan file. The plan is validated first and a stale plan fails the check. Cannot be combined with targetOrProfile or --profile.
  --continue-on-error                            Continue building remaining groups/profiles after a failure, so every build failure is reported in one run (overrides workspace.continueOnError in alwasp.json)
  --feed <feed>                                  Additional NuGet feed URL. Repeat to add multiple feeds.
  --nuget-config <nuget-config>                  Path to nuget.config used for sources and credentials
  --auth-mode <Auto|Interactive|NonInteractive>  Authentication mode for private feeds: Auto, Interactive, NonInteractive
  --feed-token-env <feed-token-env>              Feed token mapping in form 'feedUrl=ENV_VAR'. Repeat to map multiple feeds.
  --pat <pat>                                    Personal Access Token for authenticated NuGet feeds. Falls back to ALWASP_PAT environment variable.
  --config <config>                              Path to alwasp.json project configuration file (auto-detected if omitted)
  -v, --verbose                                  Enable verbose logging
  -q, --quiet                                    Minimal output
  --format <format>                              Output format: text (default), json (a single result document on stdout, human output moved to stderr), or ndjson (one JSON record per line, written as the command runs). 'jsonl' is accepted for ndjson.
  --result-file <result-file>                    Write the --format json/ndjson output to this file instead of stdout, leaving the console output unchanged. Use this for 'build', 'check', and 'workspace build', whose altool output cannot be redirected.

Description:
  ALWasp - AL symbol package restore and multi-project build tool for Business Central. Run 'alwasp config init' to get started, or 'alwasp --help' for available commands.

Usage:
  AlWasp [command] [options]

Options:

Description:
  Calculate each selected project's next version from its own current version and PERMANENTLY write it to app.json (never commits). Select projects with alwasp.json (target/profile) or, without it, with --project/--project-root. Unlike 'build', this does not restore symbols, compile, or touch git - it only updates app.json.

Usage:
  AlWasp version apply [<targetOrProfile>] [options]

Arguments:
  <targetOrProfile>  Target or profile name in alwasp.json to resolve versions for (default: defaultTarget from alwasp.json).

Options:
  --profile <profile>                                       Profile name in alwasp.json to version (config-driven mode)
  --config <config>                                         Path to alwasp.json project configuration file (auto-detected if omitted)
  --changed-since <changed-since>                           Version only projects changed since this git reference: 'latest' (newest local tag), 'latest:<pattern>' (newest local tag matching a glob, e.g. 'latest:v*'), 'latest-merge:<text>' (nearest first-parent merge whose message contains the text), or an explicit tag/branch/commit. With alwasp.json it restricts 'versioning.applyTo: changedOnly' and overrides 'changeDetection.base'; with --project/--project-root it restricts the run to the changed apps.
  --project <project>                                       Single AL project directory (direct mode; needs no alwasp.json). Cannot be combined with a positional target/profile, --profile, --config, or --project-root.
  --project-root <project-root>                             Root directory in which AL projects are discovered recursively (direct mode; needs no alwasp.json). Cannot be combined with a positional target/profile, --profile, --config, or --project.
  --app <app>                                               With --project-root: version only this app, given by name, app ID, or project path relative to --project-root. Repeat for multiple apps.
  --include-dependents                                      With --project/--project-root and --changed-since, also version the apps that (transitively) depend on a changed app (default: only the changed apps).
  --release-type <Dev|None|Preview|Release>                 How the next version is derived: Release, Preview, Dev, or None (keep the version). Default: Release without alwasp.json, else versioning.releaseType. Overrides 'versioning.releaseType'.
  --version-source <AppJson|Explicit|Nuget>                 Where each project's current version comes from: AppJson (default) or Nuget (latest published version on the configured feeds, falling back to app.json). Overrides 'versioning.source'.
  --no-dependency-update                                    Do not update the dependency entries that reference other selected projects (overrides 'versioning.includeDependencies').
  --dependency-update-scope <AllVersioned|DirectlyChanged>  Which internal versions are written into dependency entries: DirectlyChanged (default) or AllVersioned (overrides 'versioning.dependencyUpdateScope').
  --feed <feed>                                             Additional NuGet feed URL. Repeat to add multiple feeds.
  --nuget-config <nuget-config>                             Path to nuget.config used for sources and credentials
  --auth-mode <Auto|Interactive|NonInteractive>             Authentication mode for private feeds: Auto, Interactive, NonInteractive
  --feed-token-env <feed-token-env>                         Feed token mapping in form 'feedUrl=ENV_VAR'. Repeat to map multiple feeds.
  --pat <pat>                                               Personal Access Token for authenticated NuGet feeds. Falls back to ALWASP_PAT environment variable.
  -v, --verbose                                             Enable verbose logging
  -q, --quiet                                               Minimal output
  --format <format>                                         Output format: text (default), json (a single result document on stdout, human output moved to stderr), or ndjson (one JSON record per line, written as the command runs). 'jsonl' is accepted for ndjson.
  --result-file <result-file>                               Write the --format json/ndjson output to this file instead of stdout, leaving the console output unchanged. Use this for 'build', 'check', and 'workspace build', whose altool output cannot be redirected.
  -?, -h, --help                                            Show help and usage information
